title: POST /webhook/kyc/didit
$comment: Didit's payload (docs.didit.me/integration/webhooks): only the fields the handler reads are checked, and only their types, since Didit does not retry a 400 and an event refused here is lost. webhook_type and status are always sent; session_id only on session events and vendor_data only when the session was created with it, so neither is required (the handler answers a missing vendor_data with 200). Other fields, and new status values, pass through.
